description: Upcoming orbital launches from the SpaceNexus manifest (the next 50 scheduled), filterable by provider, rocket, launch site and country. Each launch has its NET date and precision, status, the date changes our ledger recorded, and its page URL. realSlips and otherDateMoves count only changes our sync saw when they happened; caughtUpDateMoves counts changes it only caught up with late (made earlier, on a day we do not know), which are never counted as slips.

country.description: Country of the launch site, by name or code, e.g. "United States", "China", "France" (Kourou), "NZL".

include_recent_outcomes.description: Also return launches flown in the last 30 days with their outcome.

limit.description: How many launches to return (1 to 20).

provider.description: Launch provider: a name or common short name, e.g. "SpaceX", "ULA", "ISRO", "CASC", "Rocket Lab".

rocket.description: Rocket, matched as a substring, e.g. "Falcon 9", "Starship", "Long March".

site.description: Launch site: a spaceport name or slug ("Cape Canaveral" includes Kennedy, "vandenberg", "Starbase", "Andoya") or any pad name.

name: next_launches
title: Next launches
